Foundations

Shared components

Generate reusable, theme-aware Material 3 components in lib/shared/components. Component manifests declare shared dependencies, so support files are created once.

Generate one component

kite --widget button

Generate a bundle

kite --widget "[button,card,avatar]"

Canonical forms:

kite component button card avatar
kite widget button card avatar
kite g widget button card avatar
i
Shell-safe list syntax

Quote the bracketed list so your shell does not interpret [ ]. The misspelling avater is accepted and normalized to avatar.

Generated output

lib/shared/components/ ├── kite_component_size.dart ├── kite_button.dart ├── kite_card.dart └── kite_avatar.dart

Available components

B

KiteButton

Filled, tonal, outlined, and text variants; sizes; loading; icons; full width; tooltip; and semantic labels.

C

KiteCard

Consistent shape and spacing, optional interaction, selection treatment, semantics, and theme-driven surfaces.

A

KiteAvatar

Remote images, loading and error fallbacks, initials, custom child content, interaction, and adaptive sizing.

S

Component foundation

A shared sizing contract required by all components and generated only once through template dependencies.

Dependency-aware generation

Each component manifest can declare:

{
  "id": "component.button",
  "requires": ["component.foundation"]
}

When button, card, and avatar are requested together, Kite resolves all requirements, deduplicates identical targets, and writes one transactional generation plan.

Example usage

KiteButton(
  label: 'Save changes',
  isLoading: state.isSaving,
  leading: const Icon(Icons.save_outlined),
  onPressed: state.isSaving ? null : controller.save,
)
